title: Amber Highlands: Underground Exploration

foundation.history: A forgotten mountain hospice once protected resin lamps, until recurring landslides forced residents to abandon it.

premise: Jori Talas, a spelunker, must map safe evacuation routes, relying on light and spatial memory despite landslides.
central_conflict: an unstable cavern network threatens the mountain hospice by restricting resin lamps.

plot_beats.name: Discovery
plot_beats.effect: The player must choose an alternative entry

plot_beats.name: Competing truths
plot_beats.cause: an unstable cavern network contests access to resin lamps
plot_beats.effect: The protagonist must reconcile independent testimony

plot_beats.name: Reconstruction
plot_beats.effect: The choice of stewardship rewrites the alliance map

endings.consequence: Locals create an autonomous stewardship cooperative
Survival is proven but structural inequity remains
